column2: # Background bands for record and normal ranges
geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = RecordLow, ymax = RecordHigh), fill = "#E18484", alpha = 0.5) +
geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = NormalLow, ymax = NormalHigh), fill = "#939393", alpha = 0.5) +
# The actual temperature lines (drawn on top of everything)
# Details like points, text, and lines
geom_point(data = record_high_days, aes(y = RecordHigh), shape = 25, size = 2.5, fill = "#AF2727") +
geom_text(data = record_high_days, aes(y = RecordHigh, label = RecordHigh), vjust = -1.5, size = 3) +
scale_x_continuous(breaks = month_info$mid_day, labels = month_info$month_abb, expand = c(0,0)) +
geom_point(data = record_precip_days, aes(y = monthly_cum_precip), shape = 25, size = 2.5, fill = "#4747B5") +
geom_text(data = cum_precip_labels, aes(x = end_of_month_day, y = final_precip, label = round(final_precip, 1)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
scale_x_continuous(breaks = month_info$mid_day, labels = month_info$month_abb, expand = c(0,0)) +
